cd /tmp/obench-cell-dn53dx5o/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_ulrt_gs8 && mkdir -p _t && cat > _t/test_pp.py <<'EOF'
import sys, os; sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
dist.init_process_group("gloo"); r=dist.get_rank(); ws=dist.get_world_size()
torch.manual_seed(0)
cfg=LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128,hidden_size=64,intermediate_size=128,num_hidden_layers=5,num_attention_heads=4,num_key_value_heads=2)
model=LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); ref=LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
inputs=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]; targets=[torch.randint(0,128,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
loss=train_step_pipeline_afab(model,inputs,targets,torch.device("cpu"),torch.float32)
tot=0
for x,y in zip(inputs,targets):
    l=F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,128),y.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward(); tot+=l.item()
md=0; cnt=0
for (n,p),(n2,p2) in zip(model.named_parameters(),ref.named_parameters()):
    if p.grad is not None: cnt+=1; md=max(md,(p.grad-p2.grad).abs().max().item())
print(r, "loss", None if loss is None else loss.item(), "ref", tot, "params w/ grad", cnt, "maxdiff", md)
dist.destroy_process_group()
EOF
torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 _t/test_pp.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn; torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 _t/test_pp.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn
